plays.quote: Kalist goes a ... bit too far forward. That's one of the ... walls we talked about. One of the angles

plays.desc_ko: Myrwn이 모퉁이를 도는 KC 멤버를 넉업으로 잡으려 이글거리는 돌진으로 위험을 감수하고 진입. 타워 아래에서 한 명을 잡았지만 Busio의 거대화(와일드 그로스로 해석)로 넉업이 막혀 대상은 생존.
plays.desc_en: Myrwn risks a Searing Charge to knock up a KC member rounding a corner and catches one under tower, but Busio's Wild Growth stops the knock-up and the target survives.
plays.quote: And Mirwin there going ... in with the steering charge. looks a ... trying to take a risk that you catch

plays.desc_ko: MKOI가 싸움을 이어가려 하자 Yike가 즉시 후방으로 낙하, Myrwn 궁극기와 동시에 대낙하가 떨어짐. MKOI가 밀리고 Jojo는 알로 쓰러진 뒤 Caliste가 마무리를 노림. KC가 MKOI를 쓸어버림(Elyoya·Alvaro 부활 대기 표시).
plays.desc_en: As MKOI tries to keep fighting, Yike drops into the backline with Grand Starfall alongside Myrwn's ultimate. MKOI is pushed back, Jojo falls into his egg and Caliste goes for the finish as KC wipes MKOI.
plays.quote: desperate to keep the fight going but ... his yike instantly into the backline. ... Alti comes in from the ore just as fire

plays.desc_ko: 한타 승리 후 KC가 진입해 타워를 철거하며 게임을 끝냄(Supa 홀로 남은 상황). 넥서스 파괴 자체는 명시되지 않으나 이후 KC 8강 진출이 선언됨.
plays.desc_en: After the teamfight, KC pushes in and tears down towers to end the game with only Supa left, and KC's advance to the quarterfinals is announced.
